endpoint_scope_decisions.decision: Existing generic natural-world owner already has soil incident edges;Vizuină uses only this soil sense,not a new planet-to-soil rewrite.
Existing labels/descriptions are general anatomical concepts. Human-qualified aliases are preserved;animal captions use the general sense and do not move or rewrite those aliases.

Bird-specific constructed/modified nesting site retained. SOR Athene noctua explicitly gives a rudimentary cleaned/scooped nest in cavities;SOR Parus major explicitly builds a material cup within hollows. No insect hive or bare cavity is made a synonym for bird-built Cuib.
Living mammal hair-covering,anatomical bird/insect wing,and familiar terrestrial shell-snail senses retained;sex/stage and hairless exceptions kept explicit.

source_limits.limit: Malformed Wikipedia higher-taxonomy infobox excluded;exact DEX and independent primary SOR identity/nesting used.
Modern Egretta colour diversity acknowledged;no universal-white or all-Ardeidae synonym assertion.
Swallow association is explicitly Muscidae-family mediated,not an observed exact-species prey record or A7 approval.
Official educational lake observation strengthens unchanged lake caption. Rovimed miceliu,fixed timings and blanket adult claims are not adopted.
Zoo-themed site is not claimed municipal authority. Romanian Science in School worksheet independently gives male wings;general handout corroborates light/larval-snail context.
Fish-scale MDA21234603 provides explicit bony/skin/protection evidence;Pește OR grammar is not alone treated as scale=bone.
Worker pollen collection is worker-role scoped;parasitic/sex/life-history universals are not asserted.
Producer lactating-sow06 corn row only;gestating05/piglet copy mismatch and all feeding recommendations excluded.
Identified animal traits may be inherited with explicit source chain;no source treatment,care advice,fixed timing/count or legal/conservation statement becomes game content.
